Develop and execute sales and marketing strategies to increase ticket sales and promote travel packages. Build and maintain relationships with corporate clients, travel partners, and agents. Prepare sales reports, forecasts, and promotional materials when required. Handle customer inquiries for air ticket bookings (domestic and international). Search and compare flight options to offer the best itinerary and price. Make reservations using GDS/online platforms (Galileo). Issue, reissue, and cancel tickets as per customer requests. Inform customers of fare rules, baggage allowance, and travel policies. Track ticket deadlines, refunds, and cancellation policies. Maintain daily reports of bookings, cancellations, and sales. Guide clients through visa application procedures for various countries. Check and collect all required documents from clients. Track and update clients on application status. Maintain accurate records of clients, documents, and application timelines. Provide pre-departure guidance to approved applicants. Core Skills: Technical Proficiency: Strong command of GDS systems, fare calculation, and ticketing processes. Attention to Detail: Accuracy in fare rules, itinerary building, and PNR handling. Customer Service: Exceptional communication and problem-solving ability. Operational Efficiency: Quick turnaround in managing multiple bookings simultaneously. Industry Knowledge: Familiar with airline policies, IATA procedures, and travel documentation. Soft Skills: Professionalism: Calm and courteous handling of client inquiries and travel disruptions. Team Collaboration: Works effectively with sales, accounts, and supplier relations teams. Adaptability: Flexible with changing travel trends, systems, and client demands. Integrity: Maintains confidentiality and compliance in all booking transactions. Reservation & Ticketing Operations Manage flight reservations, fare searches, and ticket issuance using GDS systems (Amadeus, Sabre, or Galileo). Process reissues, refunds, cancellations, and itinerary modifications promptly. Client Interaction & Support Communicate clearly with customers to confirm travel details, itineraries, and booking options. Provide accurate fare quotations

অনুসরণ করে তা নিশ্চিত করা। লগবুক ও ডিজিটাল সিস্টেমে পরিদর্শনের ফলাফল সঠিকভাবে রেকর্ড করা। প্রতিদিনের গুণগত মানের প্রতিবেদন প্রস্তুত করে আঞ্চলিক ক্রয় ব্যবস্থাপক / QA প্রধানের কাছে জমা দেওয়া। প্রতিটি ক্রয় লেনদেনের জন্য ট্রেসেবিলিটি রেকর্ড সংরক্ষণ করা। ৪. কৃষক ও সরবরাহকারী সম্পৃক্ততা কৃষক ও সরবরাহকারীদের প্রয়োজনীয় গুণগত মান, যেমন শুকানো, পরিষ্কার করা ও সংরক্ষণ পদ্
